Parse the string 'ana:91,78,85;ben:66,92,70;cara:88,95,79;dev:72,64,90;eli:95,98,93' (students separated by ';', name and scores separated by ':', scores by ','). Print each student as `name average` with the average to exactly 1 decimal place, sorted by average descending.
ref:
r=[(p.split(':')[0],sum(map(int,p.split(':')[1].split(',')))/3) for p in 'ana:91,78,85;ben:66,92,70;cara:88,95,79;dev:72,64,90;eli:95,98,93'.split(';')]
for n,a in sorted(r,key=lambda x:-x[1]): print(f'{n} {a:.1f}')

prompt:
Parse this CSV text (lines separated by 
, a header line first): 'name,qty,price
bolt,120,0.25
nut,300,0.10
gear,4,12.50
spring,16,1.75
washer,500,0.05'. Print the total value (sum of qty*price) with exactly 2 digits after the decimal point, then on the next line the name of the item with the highest unit price.

L='name,qty,price\\nbolt,120,0.25\\nnut,300,0.10\\ngear,4,12.50\\nspring,16,1.75\\nwasher,500,0.05'.replace('\\n','\n').split('\n')[1:];r=[(x.split(',')[0],int(x.split(',')[1]),float(x.split(',')[2])) for x in L]
